def chmax(a, b):

def chmin(a, b):

def topbit(t):
    if t == 0:
        return -1
    return 31 - (t.bit_length() - 1)

def topbit_ll(t):
    if t == 0:
        return -1
    return 63 - (t.bit_length() - 1)

def botbit(a):
    if a == 0:
        return 32
    return (a & -a).bit_length() - 1

def botbit_ll(a):
    if a == 0:

    return (a & -a).bit_length() - 1

def popcount(t):

def popcount_ll(t):

def ispow2(i):
    return i and (i & -i) == i

def mask(i):

def inc(a, b, c):
    return a <= b and b <= c

def mkuni(v):
    v.sort()
    v[:] = [v[i] for i in range(len(v)) if i == 0 or v[i] != v[i-1]]

def lwb(v, a):
    return bisect.bisect_left(v, a)

# Modular arithmetic
class ModInfo:
    def __init__(self, mod, root):
        self.mod = mod
        self.root = root

class Modular:
    def __init__(self, vv=0, mod=1):
        self.mod = mod
        self.v = vv % mod if vv >= 0 else (vv % mod + mod) % mod
    
    def __neg__(self):
        return Modular(-self.v, self.mod)
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return Modular(self.v + other.v, self.mod)
        return Modular(self.v + other, self.mod)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return Modular(self.v - other.v, self.mod)
        return Modular(self.v - other, self.mod)
    
    def __mul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return Modular((self.v * other.v) % self.mod, self.mod)
        return Modular((self.v * other) % self.mod, self.mod)
    
    def __truediv__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return self * other.inv()
        return self * Modular(other, self.mod).inv()
    
    def __iadd__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            self.v = (self.v + other.v) % self.mod
        else:
            self.v = (self.v + other) % self.mod
        return self
    
    def __isub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            self.v = (self.v + self.mod - other.v) % self.mod
        else:
            self.v = (self.v + self.mod - other) % self.mod
        return self
    
    def __imul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            self.v = (self.v * other.v) % self.mod
        else:
            self.v = (self.v * other) % self.mod
        return self
    
    def __itruediv__(self, other):
        return self.__imul__(other.inv())
    
    def __eq__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return self.v == other.v
        return self.v == other
    
    def __ne__(self, other):
        return not self.__eq__(other)
    
    def __lt__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return self.v < other.v
        return self.v < other
    
    def __le__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return self.v <= other.v
        return self.v <= other
    
    def __gt__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return self.v > other.v
        return self.v > other
    
    def __ge__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Modular):
            return self.v >= other.v
        return self.v >= other
    
    def __int__(self):
        return self.v
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return str(self.v)
    
    def pow(self, n):
        res = Modular(1, self.mod)
        x = Modular(self.v, self.mod)
        while n:
            if n & 1:
                res *= x
            x *= x
            n >>= 1
        return res
    
    def inv(self):
        return self.pow(self.mod - 2)

def binom(a, b):

def catalan(n):
    return binom(n, n) - (binom(n-1, n+1) if n-1 >= 0 else Modular(0, base.mod))

base = ModInfo(1, 0)

def slv():
